tools.name: check_spend_policy

tools.name: should_i_pay
tools.description: [Payment decision: may this agent pay, plus a signed audit record] May this agent pay this seller, under the buyer's rules? One call runs the spend-policy check and the x402 seller reputation check and returns one verdict (pay / dont_pay / ask_human), the reasons, both sub-results, and a signed audit record (Ed25519 decisionReceipt plus X-GW8-Receipt / X-GW8-Receipt-Signature). Verify free at POST /api/receipt/verify; public key at GET /.well-known/gw8-receipt-key (`enabled` should be true). Deterministic; stateless; never pays anyone. Free when the seller data source is down. $0.02. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment").
